note: Copy and settings for the Desde México page (/jamaica/mexico/), built by scripts/build-jamaica.mjs through scripts/_mexico.mjs. Package guide prices, per person in a double room = flight x (1 + flightMarkupPct) + the season's resort rate x (1 + hotelMarkupPct) x nights + transfer per person (pricing.transferPp, else the MBJ round-trip car from data/transfer-rates.json split between two), in US$, rounded up to $5; pesos = US$ x mxnPerUsd, rounded up to $100. Flights and resort rates come from the rate sheet: python3 scripts/import-mexico-rates.py <sheet.xlsx>, then node scripts/build-jamaica.mjs. Customer copy never names the airline.
